p.title: Same quantity computed two ways across screens: percentile conventions, legacy ADR/VCP, Weinstein stage, neutral rate, portfolio FX
p.symptom: A one-year high scored 99.8 in the fear-greed composite and market temperature but 100 in the regime radar and record percentile. The legacy stock snapshot divided ADR by the open and counted filled highs/lows, and it had no extended/pivot_down VCP stage, so the same bars read near_pivot there and extended in the screener. definitions.js called a close under a still-rising 30-week line stage 3 while chart-strategies said stage 3 is the line flattening. The macro policy axis used a fixed 1% neutral real rate beside the Taylor rule's SEP-derived 1.2%. The rates axis counted a 10-year fall during a 3%+ S&P 500 slide as 양호. The '평균 상관' warning averaged daily correlations while the matrix beside it used weekly KR–US cells, and a flat holding printed correlation 0. A KRW book's daily change applied the US stock's local return to its KRW value without the won's own move. The won-shock translation and the factor regression treated Tokyo/HK listings as USD/S&P 500. Net liquidity mixed the week-average TGA (WTREGEN) with Wednesday-level WALCL and RRP.
p.root_cause: Each reading was implemented where it was first needed. A later reader reused the label but not the function, and no gate compared the copies.
p.fix: v59.59: src/domain/shared/percentile.js percentileOf (mid-rank over the others) for F&G, temperature, radar and recordPercentile. Legacy _calcADRPercent calls AIO_ARCH.adrPctOf, and _calcVCP calls AIO_ARCH.vcpRead (the producer _calcVCPServer, loaded behind import()); filled H/L bars are marked hlFilled and skipped. weinsteinStage returns stage 2 with pullback:true under a rising line. The policy axis takes sepNeutral's r* when current. The rates axis is neutral (성장 걱정형) when the S&P 500 20-day return is at or below RULES.rates.growthScareSpx20dPct (−3). The exposure average reads the risk matrix's cells. _calcCorrelationMatrix gives null for flat or short pairs, and the heatmap prints '—'. appUsdKrwClose carries prevRate, and surface dailyChange uses (1+r)(1+fx)−1 for converted rows, or withholds the change. stress-sensitivity filters by listingCurrency. macro-history treasuryAccount is WDTGAL.
p.violated_rule: C4 one meaning one implementation; a named method follows its published definition (R265).
p.prevention: scripts/ci-quant-reference-check.mjs has cases for each (percentile extremes and ties, Weinstein pullback, SEP neutral in the policy read, KRW translation by listing currency, prevRate, flat-pair null, producer VCP legacy fields). The data-pipeline D-VCP parity now asserts that the client delegates and keeps no stage chain.
p.verification: node scripts/ci-quant-reference-check.mjs passes 37 cases. qa-runner affected passes 144; browser-responsive's theme compare-button wait timed out once under the parallel run, then passed on rerun and twice standalone, and it also passes on origin/main. The boot budget passes (the price-factors import is lazy).

changelog: **Calculation unification ({P}):** one percentile convention (a 1-year high reads 100, not 99.8), the legacy ADR/VCP now read the producer functions, Weinstein stage 2 pullback, one neutral real rate (SEP r*), a growth-scare yield fall is not 양호, KRW-book daily change includes the won move, TGA is the Wednesday level (WDTGAL).
note: Calculation unification: percentile, legacy ADR/VCP, Weinstein, neutral rate, portfolio FX, TGA
